caption: The drawing depicts two rectangular objects, both centrally aligned vertically but offset horizontally, with one larger rectangle positioned above a smaller rectangle. The larger object, located in the upper center of the composition, is a decorative rectangular pin or plaque, featuring three nested frames. The outermost frame has a mottled gold and greenish leafy pattern, while the intermediate frame is black with metallic accents, and the innermost frame has a silvery or grayish color surrounding a brownish interior, possibly simulating wood or hair. A thin horizontal pin or needle extends from the right side of the object. Below this, near the lower center, is a smaller, grayscale line drawing of a similar rectangular object, outlined in black and gray, featuring the same basic three-frame structure and horizontal pin extending from its right side. The background is a plain, off-white or beige tone, with no additional markings or objects in the composition.
title: Hair Brooch
